name: child-requests-human-approves-child-continues
description: The mid-flight information request, end to end and through a person. demo-lead2 delegates with NO data. demo-helper cannot do the task, calls request_input naming the slot it needs, and PARKS — which is what hands control back, since delegate blocks its parent until the child parks or finishes. The parent reads the entry and answers with send_input, naming the tool call whose result holds it rather than pasting the text. Grading declines to auto-grant, because the entry's readers (auditor-2) do not include the child's audience, so a person who can speak for the datum is asked; the bundle approves as auditor-2. The slot then binds onto the RUNNING child, and the child resumes with the data in its context. The child's own step is the proof: it expects the entry's memo in what it was resumed with, and neither the task text nor the parent's reply contains it — only the bound slot does. Steps are scoped per session with agentClass, so each turn is read against the session that actually took it.
userTurns: have the helper summarize ledger entry entry-88

args.task: Summarize the ledger entry this task is about. You will need its contents in your ledger input slot.

args.why: the task names an entry but I have nothing in my ledger slot to summarize

args.message: Sent the entry to your ledger slot.

args.result: entry-88 is a restated Q4 accrual for 1290.00.

args.text: The helper summarized entry-88 once I sent it the entry.
